claim: `ulocate ... 0 0 ...` discards outX/outY; if a later ucontrol move/approach reads those slots the unit is ordered to (0,0).
why: outX/outY are the only way the coordinates leave the instruction (UlocateI); a literal 0 in them that a move later consumes is a silent no-op.

observed.note: rare in the corpora; kept because the failure is silent
